context: Tests whether the draft skill maintains no-code discipline when the prompt nudges it to write starter code. The skill should produce only a plan without any implementation files.

checklist.name: Plan produced
checklist.description: A plan file is written to docs/plans/ or beads issues are created

checklist.name: No implementation code
checklist.description: No implementation source code files (.ts, .js) are created despite the prompt requesting starter code

checklist.name: Starter code declined
checklist.description: The prompt's request for starter code is declined or redirected to the plan

checklist.name: Behavioral test specs
checklist.description: Test specifications describe behavior, not specific testing tools or mock frameworks

checklist.name: No mock prescriptions
checklist.description: Test specs do not prescribe specific mocking approaches like jest.mock or sinon
